subject: Finrite security: request for KMS rotation samples and HSM attestations
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@finrite.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Dawson <mike.dawson@finrite.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: KMS/HSM rotation samples & attestations for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Finrite Bank's SIG/CAIQ review for onboarding Redwood, we need a small evidence bundle focused on encryption and key management. Could you confirm whether you can provide the following items and an expected delivery ETA?

Requested artifacts (high level):
- Sample key rotation logs (audit trail) covering a recent 90-day window (anonymized operator IDs fine).
- HSM/vendor attestation (PDF) and firmware version(s) used for tenant keys.
- Operator access matrix for KMS/HSM (roles and segregation of duties; anonymize personal IDs).
- Key ceremony minutes or notes for any split-key/escrow events in the last 12 months (redacted if needed).
- Confirmation of in-transit encryption for key material (KMS to compute nodes) and config export showing TLS/ports.
- Retention/archival policy for key metadata and rotation records.

If some items are sensitive, we can accept redacted versions or a controlled upload. Our timeline: ideally we review before the vendor audit the week of 2028-05-29. If you need an NDA or secure exchange method, flag that and I can loop in procurement.

Thanks — if easier we can do a 20-min call later today to scope.

Elena Morales
Senior InfoSec Manager, Finrite Bank
security@finrite.com

Attachments: none in this message
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@finrite.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS/HSM rotation samples & attestations for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear asks. We can assemble the bundle you described. Proposed plan and constraints below so expectations are aligned: 

Plan (what we'll provide):
- 90-day rotation/audit log sample (CSV in a ZIP) with operator IDs pseudonymized.
- HSM attestation PDF (vendor-signed) and firmware manifest; we will redact serial numbers where required per vendor T&Cs.
- Operator matrix (roles only) as CSV; we will not include personal email hashes, only role identifiers.
- Key ceremony minutes (redacted) where events are non-sensitive; we cannot share private key material or unencrypted key exports.
- A small KMS config export showing TLS ciphers and endpoint configs for in-transit proofs.
- Policy excerpt for retention/archival describing retention periods and access controls.

Constraints / notes:
- We will not provide unencrypted key material or full operator PII.
- Some HSM vendor attestation documents contain vendor-only identifiers; we will request vendor permission to include those or provide a vendor letter if restricted.

Delivery ETA: We can prepare a controlled upload link and have the first package ready within 3 business days (EOD 2028-05-22). If you need faster turnaround for a prioritized item (e.g., the attestation PDF), tell us and we will escalate.

Upload method: we will share a temporally limited Google Drive link (or S3 pre-signed URL) and a HubSpot evidence record for traceability.

If that works I'll coordinate with Marissa and Irene to start pulling artifacts.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com

Elena / Connor — I can own packaging the artifacts Connor listed. Quick notes on what we'll drop into the bundle and redaction approach: 

What I'll include:
- finrite_rotation_sample_202803.zip: contains rotation_log_sample_90d.csv (timestamps, key_id, rotation_event, pseudonymized_operator_id, action_summary).
- hsm_attestation_2027-11.pdf: vendor attestation and firmware manifest (we will remove vendor serial numbers unless you require them; if so, we can request a vendor-signed addendum).
- operator_matrix_anon.csv: role_name, role_description, separation_of_duties_flag.
- key_ceremony_minutes_redacted.txt: redacted notes and participant roles (no signatures or private key excerpts).
- kms_config_export.txt: snippet showing TLS config and endpoint listings for the control-plane-to-workers channel.
- retention_policy_excerpt.pdf: section of our KMS retention policy with contact info for compliance inquiries.

What we will NOT include:
- Private key material, full operator PII, internal ticket content that references customer secrets, or raw HSM audit logs containing vendor serials.

Security/process: we'll upload to a restricted Drive folder and share a link with 14-day expiry; access is limited to the Finrite security group emails you specified. If you need DocuSign or an NDA for the vendor docs, please indicate.

ETA: I will have a first pass bundle uploaded by EOD 2028-05-22. If the audit window requires sooner, we can prioritize the attestation PDF and rotation CSV for tomorrow morning (ask Connor to confirm).

—Marissa
